channel.title: Tuned blog
channel.description: News, guides and what's new in Tuned.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.12.0
item.description: Tuned 2.12.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Keep account side nav on /check when signed in.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.11.0
item.description: Tuned 2.11.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Speculative warm of next browse screens.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.10.0
item.description: Tuned 2.10.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Add Sign in with Apple on the Tuned account.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.9.0
item.description: Tuned 2.9.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Keep TV guide timeline still when scrolling channels. Add Premium web player at /watch.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.8.2
item.description: Tuned 2.8.2, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Highlight Backup and settings sections in account nav.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.8.1
item.description: Tuned 2.8.1, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.8.0
item.description: Tuned 2.8.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Sign in with Simkl and scrobble films and episodes alongside Trakt.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.7.0
item.description: Tuned 2.7.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Calibrate overscan, cinematic TV show pages, and manage lists in Settings.

item.title: How to add Plex, Jellyfin or Emby to Tuned
item.description: Connect a home media server to Tuned for Live TV, films and shows, with the server's own guide when it has one.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.6.0
item.description: Tuned 2.6.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. A click on a channel or show opens VLC or copies its link.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.5.6
item.description: Tuned 2.5.6, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Clarifies mini player connection behaviour while you browse.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.5.3
item.description: Tuned 2.5.3, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Can you mix the fix the merge conflicts….

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.5.1
item.description: Tuned 2.5.1, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Backups stop failing as a conflict, and the channels page says when a playlist has no copy.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.5.0
item.description: Tuned 2.5.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Turn the phone into a remote while casting.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.4.1
item.description: Tuned 2.4.1, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Channels load again on TVs and phones running Android 12 or older, and Top rated sorts by the rating on each poster.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.4.0
item.description: Tuned 2.4.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. The filters you pick on Live TV, Movies and Shows stay picked, even after Tuned closes, and each profile keeps its own.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.3.1
item.description: Tuned 2.3.1, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Home no longer freezes while your Movies and Shows load and sort.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.3.0
item.description: Tuned 2.3.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Who's watching opens faster, the TV remote starts on the first profile, and your Movies and Shows sort stays put.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.2.1
item.description: Tuned 2.2.1, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Redeeming a code on your Tuned account works again.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.2.0
item.description: Tuned 2.2.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. See real progress while your channels load, and start from your Tuned account when your provider is slow.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.1.0
item.description: Tuned 2.1.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Put Premium above Devices on the account page and confirm deleting the backup.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.0.1
item.description: Tuned 2.0.1 for Android and Android TV fixes subtitle timing, the splash screen in light mode, the welcome screen on a TV and a crash in Settings on a TV.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.0.0
item.description: Tuned 2.0 is a new install with a new app id, ready for Google Play. Your Tuned account brings your playlists, settings and profiles across in one tap.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.13.0
item.description: Tuned 1.13 adds Tuned accounts, so every device keeps the same playlists and settings, plus new home screen widgets and casting that ends when you close the player.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.12.0
item.description: Tuned 1.12 adds signing in on a TV with your phone, the new channel stack icon, a cleaner player with fit and lock buttons, and remote-friendly screens on TVs and tablets.

item.title: How to add a MAC portal (Stalker) playlist to Tuned
item.description: Sign in the way a MAG set-top box does, with the portal address and the MAC address your provider registered.

item.title: How to add an M3U playlist link or file to Tuned
item.description: Add any M3U or M3U8 link, with or without a guide link, or open an .m3u file saved on your device.

item.title: How to add an Xtream Codes playlist to Tuned
item.description: Sign in with the server address, username and password your provider sent, and get Live TV, Movies, Shows and the guide in one step.

item.title: How to cast from Tuned to a Chromecast or smart TV
item.description: Send live TV, films and episodes to a Chromecast, a TV with Chromecast built in, or a DLNA TV, including what you downloaded.

item.title: How to change the user agent in Tuned
item.description: When a server refuses to play or load your playlist, sending another player's user agent often fixes it. Here's how.
